name: pi-cowboy
description: A Herdr-native agent orchestrator for Pi. In addition to Pi itself, it can run Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and more as subagents in isolated, copy-on-write Git worktrees.

paragraphs: pi-cowboy is a multi-agent orchestrator for pi. Break a large job into focused subtasks, hand them off to background agents running in parallel, and consolidate them when they finish.

Each agent runs in its own terminal pane inside Herdr and works in an isolated copy-on-write Git worktree. You can watch agents work in real time, jump into any pane to steer them, or mix and match harnesses like Pi, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex in the same session. When the work is finished, pi-cowboy cleans up the leftovers for you.

Every running agent occupies a slot in each concurrency limit that applies to it: model, provider, harness, and global (model and provider keys can also be scoped to a harness, like opencode:provider/model). pi-cowboy queues new agents until all of their applicable limits have room. You can raise limits in /cowboy > Settings > Concurrency Settings or in your config file. See Concurrency.
